subject: Return message: "Make sure the file is sorted correctly and it is a legitimate Bismark SAM file"

messages.author: 7f28753c909e9d5e
messages.subject: Return message: "Make sure the file is sorted correctly and it is a legitimate Bismark SAM file"
parts:
I lost many hours with a wrong return message:

Running: 
my.methRaw=read.bismark(
  location=fn(sorted_norm),
  sample.id="normal",assembly="assembly22",read.context="CpG",save.folder=getwd(),
  nolap=FALSE,mincov=10,minqual=20,phred64=FALSE,treatment=0)

Mehtylkit return an error, stop processing with a message: "Make sure the file is sorted correctly and it is a legitimate Bismark SAM file"

but the reason was that Perl was not installed !!!

I recommend to change the message:
 "Make sure that Perl is installed or perhaps the file is not sorted correctly or it is not a legitimate Bismark SAM file" 

thanks
Flavio
